summary: Fiserv Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of senior notes due 20[ ]. The offering is not conditioned on any other transaction. Proceeds will be used to purchase existing 5.150% notes due 2027 and 4.400% notes due 2049 via a concurrent tender offer. The notes are unsecured and rank equally with existing senior debt; listing on NASDAQ is intended. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction—no special-situation event is present. The filing is a shelf takedown, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation.
